title: Interview: recipe repo conventions
lead: Fix the file and git conventions for `larder-recipes` (ADRs 0005, 0009, 0012).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** creating the GitHub repo or deploy key (done in "Recipe repo sync" with the owner).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The parser, importer and sync code all depend on the file layout, how headings are normalized, and how commits are made.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
1. File path: `recipes/<slug>.md` (recommended) or flat at the repo root?
2. Slug rule: from the filename (recommended), or from the title?
3. Canonical headings: `## Ingredients`, `## Directions`, optional `## Notes`. Map `## Steps` to `## Directions` (recommended)?
4. Ingredient sub-groups (e.g., "Sauce"): allow `### Sauce` under Ingredients?
5. Front matter keys to keep from Hugo (title, date, tags) and any to add (e.g., `source`)?
6. Commit identity (name/email) and message format for automated commits.
7. Branch: commit straight to `main` (recommended), or open PRs?
8. Keep `draft = true` recipes out of larder?
9. Repo license for recipe content (e.g., CC BY-SA)?

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Ask the questions with recommendations; use the sample recipes as examples.
2. Write ADR 0018 and record the raw answers in `local/` (not committed).
3. Update the parser, sync and importer slices with the decisions (`slicer edit`).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- ADR 0018 is linked from README.
- The dependent slices have no unresolved Owner input on conventions.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
